title: AAA one-time ultrasound, men 65-75 who ever smoked

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends 1-time screening for abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) with ultrasonography in men aged 65 to 75 years who have ever smoked.

numerator.quote: 1-time screening for abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) with ultrasonography

gold_notes: 1-time screening encoded as 'ever'. Smoking history is in Synthea as an observation (tobacco smoking status).
